_doc: The lana-editor commit the client packages and runs on the person's computer (electron-editor-service.js). scripts/fetch-lana-editor.js builds exactly this commit into build/lana-editor, and the package step refuses any other (scripts/editor-before-pack.js). Same shape as the backend's release/editor.lock.json; change the commit only together with a rebuild and a check that /v1/health still answers.
